categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Changes what the mining interface exposes and how block templates are synchronized rather than IPC infrastructure itself, which the category explicitly excludes.
categories.rationale: Not an IPC PR because the changes concern mining interface methods and block template synchronization rather than serialization, connection handling, or capnp machinery.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Has the Mining label and modifies `src/interfaces/mining.h`, `src/node/block_template_manager.*`, and `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp`.
categories.rationale: Resolves a data race where concurrent IPC worker threads access `CBlockTemplate` during `submitSolution()` while another thread reads from it. Ensuring thread-safe template access and exposing `getTotalFees()` directly improves the stability and completeness of the mining interface external Stratum v2 mining consumers rely on.
